designationHistory.indexText: Assabet River National Wildlife Refuge was established when former U.S. Army land at Fort Devens was transferred to the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service.

authority.citation: Transfer of former Fort Devens (U.S. Army) land under the Act of May 19, 1948 (16 U.S.C. 667b)

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Assabet River National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

USFWS, Assabet River National Wildlife Refuge: Final Comprehensive Conservation Plan (ServCat 1380): "Assabet River National Wildlife Refuge (NWR) was established in 2000 under an Act Authorizing the Transfer of Certain Real Property for Wildlife, or Other Purposes"; created when Fort Devens Army land was transferred

review.note: Established fall 2000 by transfer from the Army (CCP).
